gloss: leaving school; going home from school

definitions.gloss: leaving school; going home from school
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving school to go home at the end of the school day. The opposite of {登校|とうこう} (going to school).

examples.japanese: {下校|げこう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧だ。

⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{下校|げこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{時間帯|じかんたい}→時間帯：12971_jikantai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}して→運転する：20318_untensuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please drive carefully during the hours when children are leaving school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{下校|げこう}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Because a typhoon is approaching, it was decided to send the students home early today.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {下校|げこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to leave school for home).

USAGE:
{下校|げこう} is the opposite of ⟦{登校|とうこう}→登校：16560_toukou⟧ (going to school). It is commonly used in school announcements and traffic safety contexts. The compound {下校|げこう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (dismissal time) and {下校|げこう}⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧ (on the way home from school) are frequently seen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下校|げこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to go home from school)
- {下校|げこう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (school dismissal time)
- {下校|げこう}⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧ (on the way home from school)
- ⟦{集団|しゅうだん}→集団：03211_shuudan⟧{下校|げこう} (group dismissal, walking home in groups)
